dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli with jagged, high-contrast light perimeters. Structures exhibit a sharp transition from dark interior fur to thin, luminous boundary lines forming interlocking polygons and ellipses across the dorsal-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity light pixels are concentrated in the ventral-posterior region where annuli boundaries merge, creating dense, non-geometric light-colored zones against the dark substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli in the central-lateral region form an elongated obtuse triangle, with the primary vertex oriented towards the dorsal spine and two secondary vertices aligned longitudinally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, localized tan-colored irregular flake or temporal mark is visible in the central dorsal region among the annuli patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark flipper with five distinct, elongated digits featuring high-reflectivity claws at the distal ends.
